hook.en: Gentle massage, skin-rolling and stretching of a healed scar so it moves more freely and feels less tight.
hook.ur: Scar Mobilization mein healed scar aur aas-paas ke tissue par graded manual loading di jati hai taake comfort, mobility aur movement tolerance par kaam ho.

goal.en: By the end, you'll know what Scar Mobilization is, when it's safe and useful, how to apply it step by step — and how to prove it worked. (3 checks along the way.)
goal.ur: End tak aap jaan jayenge ke Scar Mobilization kya hai, kab safe aur faida-mand hai, qadam ba qadam kaise apply hoti hai — aur kaise prove karein ke kaam kiya. (Raste mein 3 checks.)

text.en: Scar mobilization is hands-on work on a healed scar to improve how the skin and deeper tissues move together. It starts with light technique and progresses once the wound is fully closed and healed.
text.ur: Healed scar aur surrounding tissue par dheere dheere barhta manual load diya jata hai taake comfort, mobility aur movement tolerance behtar ho sake.

simpler.en: Gentle massage, skin-rolling and stretching of a healed scar so it moves more freely and feels less tight.
simpler.ur: Scar Mobilization mein healed scar aur aas-paas ke tissue par graded manual loading di jati hai taake comfort, mobility aur movement tolerance par kaam ho.

text.en: A healed scar can be like a tight stitch in a piece of cloth. Gentle stretching helps the cloth move freely again.
text.ur: Bhara hua scar kapre mein tight silai jaisa ho sakta hai. Narm stretching se kapra phir se aazaadi se hilne lagta hai.

text.en:
Three ideas carry this whole technique:
**1.** Only start once the wound has closed with no scabs, drainage or infection, and clinical advice allows.
**2.** Move the scar in all directions, then follow with stretching.
**3.** Combine with movement exercises and self-massage.
text.ur: Mature scar progressive mechanical loading ke mutabiq adapt kar sakta hai. Manual contact se pain, sensitivity aur local mobility mein madad ho sakti hai, khaas taur par jab movement ke sath combine ho. Sirf scar ki appearance se yeh decide nahi hota ke treatment zaroori hai.

question.en: Vocabulary first — clinicians use this word a lot. What does **Adherence** mean?
question.ur: Pehle vocabulary — clinicians yeh lafz bohat use karte hain. **Adherence** ka matlab kya hai?

text.ur: Lifting and rolling the skin between your fingers.

text.en:
So when does **Scar Mobilization** make sense?
• Healed scars after surgery or injury that feel tight or limit movement.
• Cesarean, abdominal, hand or burn scars once cleared.
text.ur: Healed postoperative ya traumatic scar jo comfort ya movement ko limit karta ho.

text.en:
And just as important — when you should NOT use it, or should stop:
• Open wound, scab, discharge, infection or unhealed sutures.
• Recent surgery before clearance.
• Unexplained redness, warmth, or increasing pain.
text.ur:
Recent wound closure, radiated ya nazuk tissue, aur altered sensation.
Khula zakhm, infection, wound dehiscence ya unhealed surgical site.
Healing complete hone se pehle aggressive friction, wound changes ignore karna, aur scar appearance ko akela outcome banana avoid karein. Redness, heat, discharge, wound separation ya increasing pain par stop karke medical advice lein.

title.en: How to do it — 6 steps, each with its reason
title.ur: Kaise karein — 6 qadam, har ek ki wajah ke saath

steps.title: Check healing
steps.detail: Confirm the scar is closed and ask about surgeon advice.

steps.title: Observe and palpate
steps.detail: Note colour, thickness, tenderness and mobility.

steps.title: Start with light touch
steps.detail: Gently move the scar and surrounding skin in circles.

steps.title: Skin roll and glide
steps.detail: Lift, roll and slide the skin in different directions.

steps.title: Add gentle stretch
steps.detail: Hold a gentle stretch across the tight direction.

steps.title: Teach self-care and retest
steps.detail: Teach a short routine and check movement and tightness.

beats.ur:
1. Confirm karein ke wound band ho chuka hai aur healing status munasib hai.
2. Scar ki sensitivity, adherence aur movement par asar assess karein.
3. Halki skin movement se shuru karke multidirectional loading ki taraf progress karein.
4. Aisi movement add karein jo scar region ko tension mein laaye.
5. Function aur sensitivity dobara assess karein.

text.en: How much? Typical teaching range: 5-10 minutes per session, with self-massage a few times a day. Use light to moderate pressure.
text.ur: Jab healing kafi ho aur patient ko sahi instruction mil chuki ho, to short daily self-mobilization use ki ja sakti hai. Intensity tissue integrity ko disturb nahi karni chahiye.

beats.patient: Sofia, 33, six months after a cesarean section, tight pulling when leaning back.
beats.assessment: The scar is healed but stuck, with limited skin movement.
beats.treatment: You perform gentle skin rolling and sideways gliding for 6 minutes, then a light stretch.
beats.reassess: Skin glides better and leaning back is more comfortable. She learns a 5-minute home routine.
beats.ur:
Ek misal se poora clinical flow dekhein:
Surgery ke baad scar tabhi assess aur mobilize kiya jata hai jab healing status confirm ho aur treating team ki restrictions follow ki ja saken. Phir gentle contact ke sath relevant movement check ki ja sakti hai. Yeh illustrative example hai.

text.en:
The mistakes I see most often:
• Starting before the wound closes.
• Pressing too hard and irritating the scar.
• Not teaching self-care.
text.ur:

text.en: Evidence is limited and low quality, but scar massage may improve scar softness and movement for some. Combine with silicone or compression where indicated.
text.ur: Mobility, sensitivity, range aur daily function ko reassess karein. Scar techniques kuch patients mein comfort ya mobility improve kar sakti hain, lekin scar ko completely erase ya normal tissue mein convert karne ka promise na karein.

text.en: One line to carry into the clinic: **Wait for healing, move the scar in all directions, teach self-care.**
